attchmntText: Venky's (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: Venky's India Limited announced on 13th November 2026 that its Board of Directors approved the appointment of Col Dr Ram Vasant Athavale as an Additional Independent Director and Brig Ashutosh Dattaray Nargolkar as an Additional Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. Both appointments are subject to shareholder approval. Col Dr Ram Vasant Athavale holds DIN 12019005 and possesses expertise in CBRN Security and Risk Mitigation. Brig Ashutosh Dattaray Nargolkar holds DIN 07940176 and has experience in logistics and operations management. The company affirmed that neither appointee is related to existing directors nor debarred from holding office.

attchmntText: Venky's (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Venky's India Limited reported audited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13 November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs 1,05,501 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at Rs 2,091 lakhs. Net profit for the period was Rs 1,461 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs 10.37. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs 2,18,439 lakhs. Profit before tax was Rs 9,018 lakhs. Net profit was Rs 6,450 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs 45.85. The company noted better operational efficiency in the poultry segment. Animal health products performance was satisfactory. Oilseed segment profitability was affected by volatile soya seed prices.
